about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; charts still have to pass helm lint --strict and kubeconform.

evals.prompt: We're going to production with an RDS Postgres. Set up the chart so the app gets its database URL and migrations run on deploy.

expect.why: The Secret is referenced by name in values.
Migrations run as a PreSync Job.
The previous Job is replaced on the next sync.
TLS to RDS is verified, configured in the URL.
The Job runs the bundled runner from the app image.

reject.why: A real connection string in values.

evals.prompt: The first Argo CD sync of the app is stuck; the migrate pod shows CreateContainerConfigError.

expect.why: The Secret with DATABASE_URL doesn't exist yet.
The Job runs before anything else in the chart.

reject.why: Templating the secret value into the chart.

evals.prompt: Yesterday's migration dropped a column we still need in production. Roll it back.

expect.why: Rollback is a new forward migration.
Dropped data comes back only from the provider's backups.

reject.why: Never edit or delete a committed migration.
Rewriting the migrations table breaks every later deploy.
